description: Java class StatusBarNotifications demonstrating adding and managing notifications in Android status bar, including different moods, custom views, and default settings.

classes.name: StatusBarNotifications
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating notification handling with various mood and view options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, sets up button click listeners for different notification actions.

methods.name: makeMoodIntent
methods.description: Creates PendingIntent to launch NotificationDisplay with mood image.

methods.name: makeDefaultIntent
methods.description: Builds PendingIntent with back stack intents for deep linking into the app.

methods.name: setMood
methods.description: Builds and issues a notification with specified mood icon and message, optionally with ticker.

methods.name: setMoodView
methods.description: Creates a custom notification with RemoteViews for mood display.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Issues a notification with default sound, vibrate, or all settings.
